items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Roger was Bobby Darin’s musical director in the late 60s and wrote prolifically for television and film.

ctx.x: You’ve got to learn the power of understatement too.
Yeah. I was the guy who always wrote the charts that nobody could play. So that was Jack. And then Bobby Darin was next.
Yeah, how did that come about?
